cards.english_title: Judge Rejects Trump Bid to Hold California Ballots
cards.korean_desc: 2026년 10월 28일 카터 판사가 캘리포니아 요청을 거부했다 정부는 앞서 의심 유권자 수를 19만 명에서 줄였다 10월 28일 카터는 불확실한 의혹이 유권자 권리를 빼앗을 수 있다고 말했다
cards.english_desc: On October 28, 2026, Judge David O. Carter rejected the request in California. The government had earlier revised its estimate from 190,000 possible illegal voters. On October 28, Carter said uncertain allegations could deprive registered voters of a core right.
cards.hook: A judge rejected the ballot seizure request.
cards.takeaway_english: The ballots remain part of the election unless a later court changes the ruling.
cards.takeaway_korean: 추가 판결이 없으면 투표용지는 선거에 포함된다

why_it_matters.english: The decision affects how California counts ballots in the November 3 midterm election.
why_it_matters.korean: 이 결정은 11월 3일 선거 개표에 영향을 준다

why_it_matters.english: It also tests the balance between federal power and state election control.
why_it_matters.korean: 연방 권력과 주 선거권의 균형도 시험한다

parties.label: David O. Carter
parties.english: The federal judge refused to order ballots held aside.
parties.korean: 연방 판사는 투표용지 보류를 명령하지 않았다

parties.label: Trump administration
parties.english: The administration sought action against more than 20,000 California ballots.
parties.korean: 트럼프 행정부는 캘리포니아 투표용지를 문제 삼았다

parties.label: California
parties.english: The state kept control of its election procedures.

views.label: Trump administration
views.english: Officials argued that suspected noncitizen voting threatened election integrity.
views.korean: 정부는 비시민권자 투표가 선거를 위협한다고 말했다

views.label: California officials and voting groups
views.english: They argued that removing ballots could disenfranchise eligible voters and disrupt counting.
views.korean: 그들은 투표용지 제외가 유권자 권리를 해친다고 말했다

disagree.english: The dispute centers on uncertain voter lists and whether federal officials can intervene so close to voting.
disagree.korean: 쟁점은 불확실한 명단과 연방 개입 권한이다

cards.english_title: Spain Train Collision Kills at Least 68
cards.korean_desc: 10월 28일 스페인 톨레도 근처에서 고속열차 두 대가 충돌했다 관계자들은 69킬로미터 선로에서 자동 관제가 고장 났다고 말했다 움직이던 열차는 25킬로미터 뒤 멈춘 이리오 열차를 들이받았다
cards.english_desc: On October 28, two high-speed trains collided near Toledo, Spain. Officials said a technical failure affected automatic control on 69 kilometres of track. The moving train traveled 25 kilometres before hitting the stationary Iryo train.
cards.hook: At least 68 people died in Spain.
cards.takeaway_english: Investigators must explain the control failure before Spain can rebuild trust in high-speed rail.
cards.takeaway_korean: 조사관들은 고속철도 신뢰 회복 전에 관제 실패를 설명해야 한다

why_it_matters.english: The crash disrupted a major high-speed route between Madrid and southern Spain.
why_it_matters.korean: 사고는 마드리드와 남부를 잇는 주요 노선을 멈췄다

why_it_matters.english: It renewed questions about railway safety after another deadly crash in January.
why_it_matters.korean: 1월 사고 뒤 철도 안전 논란이 다시 커졌다

parties.label: Passengers and families
parties.english: They suffered deaths, injuries and separation after the collision.

parties.label: Renfe and Iryo
parties.english: Their trains were involved in the collision.

parties.label: Spanish government
parties.english: Officials suspended the line and began investigating the control decision.
parties.korean: 정부는 노선을 중단하고 관제 결정을 조사했다

views.label: Transport Minister Óscar Puente
views.english: He said a control centre allowed traffic to resume despite a technical failure.
views.korean: 푸엔테 장관은 관제센터가 고장 중 운행을 재개했다고 말했다

views.label: Opposition leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo
views.english: He said Spain deserved answers about the condition of its infrastructure.
views.korean: 페이후는 인프라 상태에 대한 답을 요구했다

disagree.english: The cause remains under investigation, so responsibility has not been established.
disagree.korean: 원인은 조사 중이며 책임은 아직 정해지지 않았다

cards.reader_question_korean: 올해 두 사고 뒤 스페인은 무엇을 바꿔야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Defeated Bolsonaro Claims Leadership From U.S.
cards.korean_desc: 10월 28일 플라비우 보우소나루가 브라질 결선 패배 뒤 플로리다에 도착했다 그는 자신을 당선 대통령이라 했다가 야당 지도자로 바꿔 말했다 룰라는 51.8%를 얻었고 보우소나루는 증거 없이 부정을 주장했다 10월 28일 브라질 경찰은 그를 도망자로 보지 않는다고 말했다
cards.english_desc: On October 28, Flávio Bolsonaro arrived in Florida after losing Brazil’s runoff election. He said he was Brazil’s elected president, then changed the claim to opposition leader. Lula won 51.8%, while Bolsonaro alleged fraud without evidence. On October 28, Brazil police said he was not considered a fugitive.
cards.hook: Flávio Bolsonaro fled Brazil and claimed leadership.
cards.takeaway_english: Brazil’s political conflict continues abroad while questions remain about the election claims and investigation.
cards.takeaway_korean: 선거 주장과 수사 의문 속에 브라질 갈등은 해외에서도 계속된다

why_it_matters.english: The dispute challenges acceptance of Brazil’s election result after Lula’s victory.
why_it_matters.korean: 이 분쟁은 룰라 승리 뒤 선거 결과 수용을 흔든다

why_it_matters.english: His departure also affects an investigation into alleged corruption and money laundering.
why_it_matters.korean: 그의 출국은 부패와 자금세탁 수사에도 영향을 준다

views.label: Rogério Marinho

cards.korean_title: 미 연준, 물가 상승에도 금리 동결
cards.english_title: Fed Holds Rates Steady Despite Rising Inflation
cards.korean_desc: 10월 28일 연준은 금리를 3.75%에서 4%로 유지했다 9월 물가는 3.7%였고 실업률은 4.2%에 가까웠다 위원회는 9월 회의 뒤 10대 2로 동결을 결정했다 10월 28일 두 위원은 즉시 0.25%포인트 인상을 원했다
cards.english_desc: On October 28, the Federal Reserve kept rates at 3.75% to 4.00%. September consumer inflation reached 3.7%, while unemployment stayed near 4.2%. The committee voted 10-2, after raising rates at its September meeting. On October 28, two officials wanted an immediate 0.25-point hike.
cards.hook: The Fed held rates despite 3.7% inflation.
cards.takeaway_english: The Fed is waiting, but September inflation leaves another rate increase possible later.
cards.takeaway_korean: 연준은 기다리지만 9월 물가로 추가 인상 가능성은 남았다

why_it_matters.english: Interest rates influence borrowing costs, spending and business decisions.
why_it_matters.korean: 금리는 대출 비용과 소비와 기업 결정을 바꾼다

why_it_matters.english: The decision came just days before an election focused on household costs.
why_it_matters.korean: 결정은 가계 비용이 쟁점인 선거 직전에 나왔다

parties.label: Federal Reserve
parties.english: The central bank kept its target range at 3.75% to 4.00%.

parties.label: Households and businesses

parties.korean: 가계와 기업은 계속 물가 상승을 겪는다

parties.label: Donald Trump
parties.english: His administration has repeatedly challenged the Fed’s independence.
parties.korean: 트럼프 행정부는 연준 독립성을 계속 압박했다

views.label: Federal Reserve majority
views.english: Officials said waiting would provide more data for returning inflation to 2%.
views.korean: 연준은 2% 물가 목표를 위해 자료를 더 기다린다고 말했다

views.label: Wendy Edelberg
views.english: The Brookings economist said another hike made economic sense after September’s increase.
views.korean: 에델버그는 9월 인상 뒤 추가 인상이 합리적이라고 말했다

disagree.english: Higher rates may reduce inflation but can also weaken jobs and economic activity.
disagree.korean: 금리 인상은 물가를 낮추지만 일자리와 경제를 약화할 수 있다

cards.english_title: Dolores Huerta, Farmworker Leader, Dies at 96
cards.korean_desc: 돌로레스 우에르타는 10월 28일 캘리포니아 베이커스필드에서 암으로 96세에 숨졌다 그녀는 세사르 차베스와 농장노동자연합을 세우고 파업을 조직했다 노조는 농장 노동자에게 더 나은 환경과 물과 휴식과 농약 보호를 얻었다 10월 29일 캘리포니아 지도자들과 전직 대통령들이 그녀를 추모했다
cards.english_desc: Dolores Huerta died of cancer in Bakersfield, California, on October 28, aged 96. She co-founded United Farm Workers with César Chávez and organized strikes. The union won better conditions, water, rest periods and pesticide protections for farmworkers. On October 29, California leaders and former presidents paid tribute to her work.
cards.hook: Dolores Huerta died at 96 after a lifetime of organizing.
cards.takeaway_english: Her organizing legacy remains influential, while the movement’s painful history is being reconsidered.
cards.takeaway_korean: 그녀의 유산은 남았지만 운동의 아픈 역사도 다시 평가받고 있다

why_it_matters.english: Her organizing changed protections for people who work in American fields.
why_it_matters.korean: 그녀의 조직 활동은 미국 농장 노동자의 보호를 바꿨다

why_it_matters.english: Her life connects worker rights, immigration, women’s equality and civil rights.
why_it_matters.korean: 그녀의 삶은 노동권과 이민과 여성 평등을 잇는다

parties.label: Dolores Huerta
parties.english: She spent decades organizing farmworkers and supporting civil rights.
parties.korean: 우에르타는 수십 년간 농장 노동자를 조직했다

parties.label: United Farm Workers
parties.english: The union won better conditions for many agricultural workers.
parties.korean: 노조는 많은 농장 노동자의 환경을 개선했다

parties.label: Family and supporters
parties.english: They are mourning her death and honoring her legacy.

views.label: Reuters
views.english: Her union work brought protections including rest periods, water and pesticide safeguards.
views.korean: 로이터는 그녀의 노조 활동이 휴식과 물과 농약 보호를 가져왔다고 전했다

views.label: The New York Times
views.english: Coverage also examined her disclosure of sexual abuse by César Chávez.
views.korean: 뉴욕타임스는 차베스의 성적 학대 고백도 다뤘다

disagree.english: Some may focus on her labor achievements, while others say her full legacy must include the abuse disclosure.
disagree.korean: 일부는 노동 업적을 보고 다른 사람은 학대 고백도 봐야 한다고 말한다

cards.english_title: Bnei Menashe Learn Hebrew for New Lives in Israel
cards.korean_desc: 2026년 4월 17세 제시카는 마니푸르에서 이스라엘에 와서 히브리어를 배웠다 베네이 메나셰 청소년에게 히브리어는 학교와 일과 소통에 중요하다 히브리어는 22글자를 쓰고 오른쪽에서 왼쪽으로 읽는다 2030년까지 이스라엘은 베네이 메나셰 약 5,800명을 데려올 계획이다
cards.english_desc: In April 2026, 17-year-old Jessica arrived in Israel from Manipur and began Hebrew lessons. For Bnei Menashe teenagers, Hebrew affects school, work and daily communication. Hebrew uses 22 letters, reads right to left and usually omits vowels in printed text. By 2030, Israel plans to bring about 5,800 remaining Bnei Menashe members.
cards.hook: Hebrew is becoming the key to Israel’s next chapter.
cards.sticker: A new language, a new life
cards.korean_hook: 히브리어가 이스라엘 새 삶의 열쇠가 됐다
cards.takeaway_english: The migration plan’s success will depend on language teaching and support after arrival.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이주 계획의 성공은 도착 뒤 언어 교육과 지원에 달렸다

why_it_matters.english: Language ability affects access to education, work and everyday life.
why_it_matters.korean: 언어 능력은 교육과 일과 일상생활에 영향을 준다

why_it_matters.english: Thousands of people may move from northeastern India to Israel by 2030.
why_it_matters.korean: 수천 명이 2030년까지 인도 북동부에서 이스라엘로 갈 수 있다

parties.label: Bnei Menashe
parties.english: Members from Manipur and Mizoram are moving to Israel through religious recognition and conversion.
parties.korean: 베네이 메나셰 사람들은 종교 인정과 개종을 거쳐 이스라엘로 간다

parties.label: Jessica
parties.english: The 17-year-old is learning Hebrew after arriving from Manipur in April 2026.

parties.label: Israeli government
parties.english: It approved bringing about 5,800 remaining community members by 2030.

views.label: Bnei Menashe members
views.english: Hebrew classes can help newcomers study, work and become independent in Israel.
views.korean: 히브리어 수업은 공부와 일과 자립을 도울 수 있다

views.label: Critical perspective in the coverage
views.english: Migration alone does not guarantee better education because students need institutional support.
views.korean: 이주만으로는 부족하고 학생들은 제도적 지원도 필요하다

disagree.english: Some may see language training as opportunity, while others may worry that interrupted schooling creates unequal results.
disagree.korean: 일부는 기회로 보고 다른 사람은 교육 중단이 격차를 만든다고 걱정한다

cards.reader_question_korean: 새 학교에 가기 전 젊은 이주민은 어떤 지원을 받아야 할까요?
cards.source_title: Learning Hebrew to be Israeli: How education is shaping the Bnei Menashe community’s journey
caption_lines: Israel approved the migration plan in November 2025.
